name: interrupt-state-set
intent: Set whether maskable interrupts may be delivered on the current hardware thread.
postconditions: interrupt delivery state matches enabled before return
ordering: compiler and machine effects must not cross the state transition when doing so changes observable interrupt behavior

name: address-space-activate
intent: Make a supplied address-space object the active translation context for the current hardware thread.
preconditions: root and required kernel mappings are valid
postconditions: subsequent translations use the supplied space
ordering: mapping publication precedes activation; required translation invalidation completes before return
failure_semantics: invalid roots are rejected without partial activation

name: translation-invalidate
intent: Make obsolete translations unusable within a requested semantic scope.
preconditions: scope describes a valid backend operation
postconditions: no invalidated stale translation may be observed after return
ordering: page-table updates happen before invalidation completion

name: memory-order-enforce
intent: Enforce an explicitly requested ordering relation for shared-memory operations.
preconditions: the requested order describes the caller's synchronization intent
postconditions: operations are ordered at least as strongly as requested
ordering: relaxed, acquire, release, acquire-release, or sequentially consistent
source_mapping: x86-64 compiler barriers and fences as required
target_mapping: RV64 fences and atomic ordering as required
known_non_equivalences: x86 TSO may satisfy relations that RVWMO requires code to express
